environment.description: Pipeline plugin deployed inside a bubblewrap (bwrap) sandbox with pivot_root to /opt/pipeline-chroot. The chroot contains only the Python runtime, application code, and an empty /var/run/secrets/ directory (tmpfs mount, 0 bytes quota, noexec). The /etc/pipeline/ path resolves to an empty directory within the chroot. Process runs under a dedicated UID (65534) with PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS. Seccomp profile (based on docker/default minus socket-related calls beyond AF_INET) applied. The session store is in-process memory only - no persistence layer accessible. Network namespace restricts outbound to localhost:5432 (postgres for auth) only via nftables egress rules.

config.network_namespace: nftables egress allow only 127.0.0.1:5432, drop all other outbound
config.sensitive_files: none present in chroot - all secret paths resolve to empty dirs/files
